title: Mathematics in the Library of Babel
author: Daniel Litt

metaphors.title: Library of Babel
metaphors.paraphrase: A library holding proofs of every ZFC theorem plus guides; a mathematician inside would still get to work, because the goal is understanding.

metaphors.title: Clinging to a giant edifice
metaphors.paraphrase: Research as feeling out a huge structure, bashing your skull into an object until its texture imprints on your forehead.
